centring_convention_note: rho_centred_* is mean-centring; rho_centred_by_median_* is median-centring. Both are shift-invariant; they differ by ~0.06 because the residual distribution is skewed.

magnitude_prior_verdict.why: The statistic rho(|residual|, |predicted|) is uninterpretable here, in either sign. residual = observed - predicted, so |residual| contains |predicted| by construction. The correct null - shuffle observed within assay and REBUILD the residual, preserving the construction - gives median +0.505, which is LARGER than the observed +0.313; observed exceeds the null in only 11 of 48 assays.
magnitude_prior_verdict.reviewer_agrees: Reviewer F2/F3 reached the same withdrawal; its centred figure was +0.373 (median-centring) and its permutation null +0.349.
magnitude_prior_verdict.what_replaces_it: The position effect (H2) and residue identity (H1), which have valid nulls and survive them.
